title: Amount of the Early-Closure Returned-Fee Relief - Credit Builder Accounts
content:
The early-closure returned-fee relief on a Credit Builder Accounts account is the base relief share of the returned-payment fee, rounded to the cent. The base relief share is 0.2, that is 20 percent.

## The fee, the return and the request

The relief applies to the returned-payment fee charged for the account's most recent returned payment; when two payments were returned on the same day, the one booked first counts as the most recent. The return looked at is that most recent returned payment: its return date is the date of its return line, and the request looked at is the account's pending early-closure request, dated the day it was registered.

The relief is not owed, and nothing is booked, when the account's most recent returned payment carries no returned-payment fee, when that fee already carries a fee waiver or a fee payment, or when the relief comes to 0.00; an older returned-payment fee gets no early-closure relief. A returned-payment fee entry names the returned payment it was charged for; a fee carries a waiver or a payment when a fee waiver entry or a fee payment entry points at it.

## The amount

The relief share is applied to the fee's amount; a relief share is never more than 100 percent (a share of 1.0). The relief is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end, a half cent or more rounding up, and it is never more than the fee.

## Hypothetical cases

| Most recent returned payment | Its returned-payment fee | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| returned with a code that carries no fee; an older return has an unpaid fee of 10.00 | none | not owed: the older fee gets no early-closure relief |
| fee 10.00, already waived | 10.00, waived | not owed |
| fee 10.00, unpaid | 10.00 | 20 percent of 10.00, that is 2.00 |
| fee 6.35, unpaid | 6.35 | 1.27 |
